extension.summary: Mafab.hu movie database: trailers, movie lists, search
extension.description: A Mafab.hu magyar filmadatbázis böngészése Kodiból: előzetesek és videók, legjobb filmek és sorozatok, új adatlapok, keresés. Nem hivatalos kiegészítő.
Browse the Hungarian Mafab.hu movie database from Kodi: trailers and videos, best movies and series, new entries, search. Unofficial add-on.
extension.news: 0.9.9 - New source adapter: VIDEALETOLTES (videaletoltes.com); identical embeds from two adapters shown once; 0.9.8 - Host rows: quality coloured (4K, 1080p, 720p, HD, SD, DVD, CAM); 0.9.7 - Fix: a 403 to the availability probe no longer blocks playback (fallback to other resolver, then handed to the player); 0.9.6 - HD badge from MoziPont/MoziBox shown as quality on the host rows; 0.9.5 - Fix: host list no longer aborts on older Python (cancel_futures); a refused (403) stream falls back to the next resolver; 0.9.4 - Fix: skipped ResolveURL link test returned the wrong shape (TypeError); 0.9.3 - Slow CDNs no longer rejected: ResolveURL link test skipped, availability check only rejects 404/410; 0.9.2 - New source adapter: MOZIPONT; faster on Android (resolver loaded only when needed, host support remembered, menu cached, page parsed once); 0.9.1 - New source adapter: MOZIBOX (mozibox.hu); 0.9.0 - Faster: adapters searched and listed in parallel, mirror links resolved in parallel, leaner page parsing; [perf] timing lines in kodi.log; 0.8.8 - No hand-off to another add-on for a link the resolver already failed on; an unreachable domain is tried only once per attempt; 0.8.7 - Host search ignores same-title films of another year; 0.8.6 - Setting: list only hosts ResolveURL supports (default on); 0.8.5 - A host that hangs no longer freezes Kodi: 25 s limit per host, Cancel works during resolving; 0.8.4 - New setting: how many list items get full details (default 10), search shows 20 per page; 0.8.3 - Search shows 15 hits per page (details fetched only for those); 0.8.2 - Search: real result markup (all hits on one page, series flag, year, rating, art, genres), celebrities block; 0.8.1 - Search: tries the site's own /search/&search= URL first, ignores sidebar films in results; 0.8.0 - People menu (popular, actors, directors, writers, composers, cinematographers); 0.7.2 - TV list: time no longer shown twice; 0.7.1 - TV schedule: film/series decided by the site series filter; 0.5.1 - premiere date in the info panel; 0.5.0 - yellow year, facts line and credits in the info panel, more details from the detail page; 0.4.2 - year from list markup and more detail-page fallbacks;
